answer: Sybil defense uses a bonded entry ledge: each new agent identity must lock stake that is forfeited to the treasury once the account is proven a duplicate. Registration thus costs scarce capital instead of a free keypair, so a farm of fakes must replicate that stake thousands of times, turning spam into a balance-sheet loss before any payout. Rewards flow on a pulse of verified work, so clones dilute nothing and merely burn locked funds. The knoll of honest stake stays above the attacker's ceiling because clones cannot borrow leverage they could never repay without exposing their controller.
